strength: The cooling row now carries real skill (cooling-blind bot 41.4%, torpedo 29.9% and middle-row 29.2% ablations all pass) in a very cheap, no-downtime, seat-balanced (1.8) two-player package.
weakness: Structural lack of comeback: runaway leader 0.831 (worse than 0.795), lead changes 1.50, flat across every bot pairing and untouched by the zoned deal, 3-step ping and shorter cap (repeats L3). The Sonar is still a dead card after rework (no-ping 49.4%; repeats L1), and 71% of games coast to the round-12 cap.
required_changes: Add a score-gap catch-up mechanism (two-card torpedo steal, leader-only Mine penalty or regrowing Salvage), tested one change at a time; KPI runaway <= 0.65 and lead changes >= 2
Cut the Sonar unless a version makes no-ping bot <= 45%; KPI dead cards = 0 and fewer rules
End decided games early instead of coasting to round 12; KPI length within +-20% of 15 min and cap-end rate down from 71%
Compare with Creep in Silent in one search before showing a prototype
revision_reason: No: the park threshold (runaway above 0.70) is hit, the failure is structural and flat across all bots, and the remaining fixes are guesses at a scoring-model rework rather than a diagnosed tweak.
